title: Sleek styling vs clunky feel and controls
summary: Feedback in this topic contrasts sleek, sporty styling and comfort with complaints that the vehicle or entertainment controls feel clunky.

positive.summary: Positive feedback highlights sleek, sexy styling, quietness, and very fast performance.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the car no longer feels sleek and that the entertainment system is clunky and click-heavy to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention sporty, comfortable design and strong comfort but do not provide enough context to confirm clear sentiment.

limitations: The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative.
This topic combines exterior design impressions, comfort comments, and entertainment-system usability rather than one single coherent issue.
The undetermined examples are too brief to confidently interpret sentiment beyond their stated attributes.
